checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Create draft event group as the seed for an RFQ-only event

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Reject event group creation when line_items is entirely absent
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 422 with error code 2 ('Insufficient parameters'), rendered by Api::EventGroupsController#create before authorize EventGroup, because boq_based_rfx is falsy and params[:line_items] is blank. Zero rows written to event_groups.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with status and title only, omitting line_items.
2. Assert HTTP 422 with a numeric error code.
3. Assert no EventGroup row was created for this title.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser; the workspace does NOT have boq_in_erfx_allowed enabled and no config.boq_based_rfx is sent.

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Non-existent product_uuid on line item must not crash event group creation
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 4xx expected (422 with a numeric code). Risk being probed: get_details_for_event_group_line_items does products.find { ... } then dereferences product.id, so an unmatched product would raise NoMethodError on nil and surface as 500. Either way the transaction must roll back and leave zero event_groups rows.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a line item whose product_uuid decodes to an id with no matching active Product.
2. Assert the response is a controlled 4xx and NOT a 500.
3. Assert no partially-created EventGroup is left behind, since create_line_items runs inside the ActiveRecord::Base.transaction.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser. The decoded product id does not exist, or exists but is not Product.active in this workspace.
checkResults.verdict: server error 500 — a 5xx is always a defect

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Negative and non-numeric quantities must not be silently coerced into a valid event
checkResults.expectedResult: No 5xx. Documented hazard: the helper uses quantity[:value].to_f, so 'ten'.to_f becomes 0.0 and silently flips is_rate_only to true, while -5 survives as -5.0. A negative or silently rate-only line item must be refused with a numeric error code rather than persisted.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with two line items: one with quantity value -5 and one with quantity value 'ten'.
2. Assert the response is a controlled 4xx, or if accepted, assert the stored quantities are never negative.
3. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/get_line_items and inspect the persisted quantity values.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser; {{productUuid}} and {{productQualityUuid}} are active.

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Cross-tenant product_uuid must not be attachable to an event group
checkResults.expectedResult: No 5xx and no data leak. Expected outcome is HTTP 422 with a numeric error code; the created EventGroup (if any) must carry company_id = Current.workspace.id only and must not expose the foreign product's name or quality params in meta_data.
steps: 1. Obtain a product uuid owned by a different tenant.
2. POST /event_groups as company A referencing that foreign {{productUuid}}.
3. Assert the request is refused or the product is not attached, and no cross-tenant product name leaks in the response body.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated as a purchaser of company A. {{productUuid}} is a Product that belongs to company B and is not visible to company A.
